root-cap periphery1 (UniProt A0A804N744 'Root cap protein 1'); dissected-cap bulk 290k vs <=2.3k (Ortiz-Ramirez 2021) and Columella cluster log2FC 4.2 (Guillotin 2023). Same lab and shared libraries, so not counted as independent; published cap-periphery localization not re-verified.
root cap periphery gene2; dissected-cap bulk 211k vs <=2k (Ortiz-Ramirez 2021) and Columella cluster 20x over the next type (Guillotin 2023). Not counted as independent (same lab).
Root-cap gene name; Columella DE in Wang 2025 (0.69 vs 0.37) and Guillotin Columella 5.0 vs Epidermis_2 3.4. Agreement but weak specificity in both, so not raised.

Glycine-rich protein4 (GRMZM2G025205); HCR strong in outer root cap and outer layers (Guillotin 2023 ED Fig 7n); top of the cap-like Epidermis_2 cluster; bulk epidermis 10.6k and cap 7.7k vs cortex 0.7k (Ortiz-Ramirez 2021). Also epidermis: use with cap genes.
Uncharacterized; Ortiz-Ramirez 2021 Fig 2E marker of merged Epidermis/LRC cluster 7; bulk cap 213k > epidermis 95k > cortex 65k (not clean).

WUSCHEL-related homeobox 5b (UniProt A8Y7W0), QC identity gene class (WOX5/QHB); native-promoter GFP and in situ in the QC (Cao et al. 2023 Plant Biotechnol J Fig 5a,b); WOX5-reporter-sorted QC bulk 198 vs <=2 (Ortiz-Ramirez 2021). Barely detected in scRNA/snRNA (no QC cluster in any dataset).
WUSCHEL-related homeobox 5A (MaizeGDB wox5a); WOX5-reporter-sorted QC bulk 102 vs <=2 (Ortiz-Ramirez 2021); which paralog drove the sorting reporter is unresolved; undetected in scRNA.

Gly-rich protein (uncharacterized); outermost-layer in situ ring (Wang 2025 Fig 1D); top of Guillotin 2023 Epidermis_2/3 clusters; bulk epidermis 23k vs cap 9k, cortex 6k (Ortiz-Ramirez 2021). Broad: also high in Wang 'Initials' (pct 0.84) and cap.

OUTER CELL LAYER1, L1-specific HD-ZIP IV in embryo/shoot (Ingram et al.; not re-verified); epidermis DE in Wang 2025 (0.60 vs 0.12) and Guillotin 2023 (modest); bulk epidermis 4.5k vs cortex 2.6k, cap 2.3k.
Glycine-rich cell wall protein-like; epidermis DE in Wang 2025 (0.67 vs 0.11) and top of Guillotin Epidermis_3/Trichoblast/Epidermis_2 (all epidermis).
HCR weak in epidermis (Guillotin 2023 ED Fig 7l), but bulk cortex 3.7k > epidermis 2.7k and Wang 2025 lists it in Columella: not specific.
Lipid transfer protein; cortex in situ (Cao 2023 Fig S3a); cortex DE in Cao (cl 8/16), Wang 2025 (0.71 vs 0.46) and top of Guillotin 2023 Cortex_1; bulk cortex 18.9k (Ortiz-Ramirez 2021).

LTP-domain protein; cortex in situ (Cao 2023 Fig S3a); cortex DE in Ortiz-Ramirez 2021 (cl13), Wang 2025 and Guillotin Cortex_1. Not raised: weak specificity (bulk cortex 2.3k vs stele 1.1k; Wang pct 0.31 vs 0.17). v4 model maps to Zm00001eb249760 and Zm00001eb249770.

NAD-dependent epimerase/dehydratase (uncharacterized); HCR cortex (Guillotin 2023 ED Fig 7h); top of Guillotin Cortex_1; bulk cortex 15.7k vs stele 4.9k, epidermis 3.5k (Ortiz-Ramirez 2021, same lab, not counted as independent).
Zea root protein2 (BURP domain), a known root cortex transcript (not re-verified); HCR moderate in cortex (Guillotin 2023 ED Fig 7i); highest in young-cortex Cortex_4; bulk cortex 550 vs <=145.
Lipid transfer protein named PLT29 by Wang 2025; cortex in situ (Wang Fig 1D) but weakly specific (pct 0.68 vs 0.43; bulk QC 2.4k, cortex 1.9k, stele 1.4k).
Thiazole synthase; inner cortex by HCR and Molecular Cartography (Guillotin 2023 ED Fig 7d), but weak in scRNA and QC-high in bulk (170 vs cortex 37).
Class III peroxidase; cortex in situ (Cao 2023 Fig S3a); bulk cortex 8.5k vs epidermis 4.4k; but top Guillotin cluster is LRC (outer-layer stress state).
Uncharacterized; cortex in situ (Cao 2023 Fig S3a); bulk cortex 30k > cap 14k; top Guillotin clusters are LRC/Trichoblast. v4 maps to Zm00001eb328300 and Zm00001eb328290.

SCARECROW (UniProt Q9FUZ7); endodermis in situ and promoter reporter (Ortiz-Ramirez 2021 Fig 1A, 3G), maize function (Hughes et al. 2019 Development); SCR1-sorted bulk 1.3k vs <=117. Poorly detected in scRNA: not enriched in any Guillotin cluster nor a Wang 2025 endodermis DE gene.

SHORT-ROOT paralog; in situ and SHR1-YFP (Ortiz-Ramirez 2021 Fig 3E,F) and weak HCR (Guillotin 2023 ED Fig 7e); bulk endodermis 135 vs stele 34. Maize SHR transcripts are endodermis-enriched (unlike Arabidopsis); barely detected in scRNA.

SHORT-ROOT paralog; endodermis in situ + reporter and shr2/shr2-h double mutant has fewer cortex layers (Ortiz-Ramirez 2021). ID inferred by matching GSE172280 bulk values to Fig 3A (paper Table S2 not accessible); bulk endodermis 640 vs <=105.
SHORT-ROOT paralog; endodermis in situ and double mutant (Ortiz-Ramirez 2021). ID inferred from bulk values as for ZmSHR2; bulk endodermis 147 vs <=41.
Class III peroxidase; endodermal-ring in situ (Cao 2023 Fig 2f) but low in bulk (42 vs stele 26) and absent from Guillotin 2023.
Phytocyanin; endodermal-ring in situ (Cao 2023 Fig S3e), but bulk endodermis 2.2k = stele 2.0k and top Guillotin cluster is Stele_2.
Ortiz-Ramirez 2021 Fig 2E marker of Endodermal Initials (cl12); SCR1-sorted bulk 11.3k vs stele 1.5k; top Guillotin cluster is Stele_2.

CONFLICT (endodermis vs phloem module): HCR in phloem poles in maize and sorghum ortholog inside the endodermal ring (Guillotin 2023 Fig 2b, ED 7f; Phloem cluster 13x). Top endodermis marker in Ortiz-Ramirez 2021 (Endodermis (M); SCR1-sorted bulk 37k vs stele 8k) and Wang 2025 (0.89 vs 0.07); Cao 2023 called its cluster root cap. Placed in Phloem: only two-colour cell-resolution evidence, and SCR1 is not co-enriched. Check SCR1/SHR vs SUT1 co-expression in data.

CONFLICT (endodermis vs phloem module): Wang 2025 in situ ring near the endodermis (Fig 1D, low resolution) and endodermis DE (0.87 vs 0.07); Guillotin Phloem-cluster specific (11.4 vs <=0.75); SCR1-sorted bulk 3.8k vs stele 1.0k. Same module as Zm00001d049606.
CONFLICT (endodermis vs phloem module): HCR weak in phloem (Guillotin 2023 ED Fig 7k), Phloem cluster 19x; SCR1-sorted bulk 2.1k vs stele 0.6k. Same module as Zm00001d049606.
CONFLICT (endodermis vs phloem module): Wang 2025 endodermis DE (0.69 vs 0.02); Guillotin Phloem 8.7 vs <=0.8; SCR1-sorted bulk 6.8k vs stele 0.4k.
CONFLICT (endodermis vs phloem module): Wang 2025 endodermis DE (0.51 vs 0.01); Guillotin Phloem 7.4 vs <=0.5.
CONFLICT (endodermis vs phloem module): Cao 2023 in situ at cap tip (called root cap, Fig 2e; contradicted by bulk cap 0); Guillotin Phloem 13.8 vs <=1; SCR1-sorted bulk 12.2k.

Root specificity not shown: bulk stele 4.6k = SCR1-sorted 4.3k vs cortex 0.2k; weak in scRNA (Guillotin Pericycle/Stele_2/Phloem 0.29-0.38). Added from paper tables, not from the reviews.

Polygalacturonase45; HCR + Molecular Cartography ring at the stele periphery (Guillotin 2023 ED Fig 7c, 'young stele/pericycle'); peaks in Guillotin Young_Phloem, whose cells Ortiz-Ramirez 2021 called Pericycle/Endodermis (E); bulk stele 304 vs cortex 107.
Dirigent protein; pericycle in situ (Wang 2025 Fig 1D) and pericycle DE (0.75 vs 0.06); top Guillotin cluster Stele_2 (0.79); not specific in bulk (cortex rep 1.5k, stele 0.4k).
Pericycle DE in Wang 2025 (0.35 vs 0.01) and top of Guillotin Young_Phloem (Molecular Cartography probe, no image). Agreement holds only if Young_Phloem is pericycle.

Uncharacterized; HCR moderate in young stele (Guillotin 2023 ED Fig 7m); Wang 2025 Stele (0.43 vs 0.08) and Pericycle DE; bulk stele 2.6k, endodermis 1.7k vs cortex 0.4k. Not raised: stele vs pericycle not separated.
Uncharacterized; stele in situ (Wang 2025 Fig 1D), Wang Stele DE (0.40 vs 0.11); flat across Guillotin stele bins.

Class III peroxidase; stele in situ (Cao 2023 Fig S3g), Cao central-pith cluster 14 (log2FC 2.7); bulk stele 7.0k vs <=0.6k; top of Guillotin 'Endodermis', whose cells Ortiz-Ramirez 2021 called Pith. Central pith is a grass (polyarch) feature.

L-gulonolactone oxidase-like; stele in situ (Cao 2023 Fig 2f); bulk stele 1.0k vs SCR1-sorted endodermis 64; top of Guillotin 'Endodermis' (its HCR mostly weak or absent, ED 7g), i.e. 2021 Pith cells.
Phytocyanin; central-pith in situ (Cao 2023 Fig S3h,i), Cao cluster 14 log2FC 3.3; but low in bulk (stele 43) and ~0 in Guillotin.

Secondary-wall cellulose synthase (CESA4/7/8 class; not re-verified); Guillotin 2023 Xylem 0.15 vs <=0.01; bulk stele 919 vs <=65. Added from paper tables. v4 maps to Zm00001eb046440 (CESA) and Zm00001eb046430 (eIF-iso4F).
Uncharacterized; xylem DE in Wang 2025 (0.63 vs 0.08) and Guillotin 2023 (18x); bulk stele 290 (whole tip 637). No B73 v5 counterpart in the MaizeGDB xref.

S1-type nuclease; metaxylem in situ (Cao 2023 Fig S3f), Cao xylem cluster log2FC 3.3; but bulk highest in columella and absent from Guillotin ST1.
Uncharacterized; Guillotin 2023 Xylem DE (Molecular Cartography probe, no image); bulk stele 2.1k = cap 2.3k.

APC/C activator CDC20 (mitosis); Wang 2025 'Initials' DE (0.79 vs 0.26).
